text: API needs rate limiting. A fixed-window counter in Postgres could work.
Maybe fixed-window is fine, it is the simplest thing.
Actually a fixed-window counter won't work, bursts at window edges double the rate. We decided to use a token-bucket limiter in Redis instead.
